svg.text: Career Mentor — Detailed Architecture
Student / Browser
Frontend — Streamlit (Streamlit Community Cloud, single-file app.py)
Pages: Auth (login/signup/forgot-password) · Assessment (RIASEC + marks + skills) · Dashboard (ranked matches) · Roadmap (checklist)
Mentor (chat) · Explore (compare careers / bookmarks / deadlines / directory) · Colleges (directory) · Scholarships (catalog) · Admin (CRUD)
State: st.session_state caches profile/score/insights/bookmarks; JWT mirrored into URL query string so refresh doesn't log out
api_client.py — server-to-server HTTP calls via requests, secrets from st.secrets / .env
Backend — FastAPI (Render, free web service, port $PORT)
Routers
/auth (signup, login, me, change-password, forgot/reset-password)
/profile · /careers · /colleges (public read)
/score , /score/insights (ranking + LLM explanations)
/mentor/chat · /roadmap · /bookmarks · /admin/careers (admin-only)
GET /health — polled by keep-alive to prevent Render cold-sleep
Services
auth.py — bcrypt password hashing + JWT issue/verify
db.py — PyMySQL access layer, init_db() creates/seeds schema on boot
scoring_engine.py — pure-Python, deterministic, explainable
weights: RIASEC 40% · Academic fit 30% · Interests 20% · Skill gaps 10%
llm_client.py — provider wrapper (insights, mentor replies, resume prep)
catches API errors/timeouts → returns pre-written fallback text (demo-safe)
Every endpoint except /auth/*, GET /careers, GET /colleges requires Authorization: Bearer <JWT>; admin routes also check is_admin
HTTPS / JWT Bearer
Database — MySQL (Aiven, managed, TLS)
students · careers · colleges · mentor_chat
roadmap_steps · insights · bookmarks
career_prep · password_resets
List/dict fields stored as JSON columns (small curated dataset,
no join overhead needed)
init_db() auto-applies database/schema.sql and seeds careers_seed.json /
colleges_seed.json on first boot; ALTER TABLE migration checks after that
AI Layer — LLM (pluggable)
Gemini (default, gemini-1.5-flash)
OpenAI (gpt-4o-mini) · Ollama (local, llama3.2)
Used for: career insights + roadmap text,
mentor chat replies, resume/interview prep
Selected via LLM_PROVIDER env var; on failure/timeout
falls back to a pre-written template so the demo never breaks
SQL (TLS)
HTTPS
Deployment & Uptime
Frontend → Streamlit Community Cloud · Backend → Render (free web service, render.yaml blueprint) · DB → Aiven (free managed MySQL)
scripts/keep-alive.sh (cron, every ~10 min) or an external ping service hits GET /health on the backend and the frontend URL
to prevent Render's free tier from sleeping the service after 15 minutes idle (avoids the ~30-50s cold-start penalty)
